lessons_used: Reordering sign-in can be helpful (won after adoption selection at +5.5% and photo upload at +3.3%), but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).

Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1%) and path selection helper hints (+3.3%) were helpful, but sound cue notifications, notification toggles, and desktop overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Copy updates and waiting screen progress/time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Visual redesigns and layout changes showed no clear effect or caused severe negative drops (-17.2%) and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions were frequently over-optimistic for non-winning tests, predicting up to +12.0% where no clear effect was measured.
Predictions underestimated several wins, such as sign-in reordering after photo upload (-8.0% predicted vs +3.3% measured) and path helper hints (+0.2% predicted vs +3.5% measured).

candidates.title: Stage Layout Pick Friend Experience
candidates.change: Redesign the Pick Friend screen using a stage layout featuring a pet preview component and stylized companion selection cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%. A stage layout creates a clearer visual focus for companion selection.

guard.reason: Redesigns Pick Friend layout while preserving companion selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Visual redesigns on adoption historically show severe drops (-10.9%).

candidates.title: Desktop Mascot Placement Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen 'new_placement_guide' right before home intro that demonstrates how desktop pet positioning and interactions work.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and support received multiple emails from users confused about how to control or view their pet on desktop.

new_placement_guide.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
new_placement_guide.body: Your pet lives directly on your desktop screen. Click and drag to reposition, or right-click to interact.

guard.reason: Adds a new placement guide screen within onboarding without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Both support emails and funnel point to finish drop-off, but adding a screen increases friction.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend Selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in immediately after choosing a friend (pick_friend) and before photo upload or certificate confirmation.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in after adoption selection improved conversion by 5.5% earlier; placing it right after pick_friend captures commitment before upload work.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in within onboarding while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in right after adoption selection was a proven win (+5.5%).

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Archetype Quiz Flow
candidates.change: Insert a short quiz flow 'new_path_quiz' before choose_path to help users decide between preset pets and custom avatar creation.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s (median 8s), showing that undecided users stall significantly before choosing a path.

new_path_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Pet Match
new_path_quiz.body: Answer two quick questions to discover whether a ready-made pet or custom creation suits you best.

guard.reason: Adds a new quiz flow before choose_path without removing or skipping required screens.

candidates.score_note: Inserting a new quiz flow adds significant friction to a step with an 8s median duration.

candidates.title: Official Companion Stamp Incentive on Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Add an official adoption verification badge and confirmation action card on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9%; adding visual ownership validation increases motivation to complete certificate setup.

guard.reason: Adds an official adoption badge to the certificate screen while retaining official stamp certification.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step (60.9%) with low-risk motivation card.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Shortcut Hint on Home Intro
candidates.change: Add a dedicated shortcut key hint on the home intro screen detailing desktop control keybindings.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent inquiries after onboarding from users confused about how to control, hide, or summon their desktop pet.

home_intro.hint: Quick tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime or right-click your pet to open quick desktop controls.

guard.reason: Adds shortcut hint text to home_intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from support inquiries and low cost, though hint impact is generally mild.

candidates.title: Two Column Layout for Choose Path Screen
candidates.change: Switch the choose path screen to a two-column layout side-by-side comparing preset pets and custom creations.
candidates.why: The high mean duration on choose_path (514s) indicates friction in evaluating options; a side-by-side comparison reduces cognitive load.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Notification Banner on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Enable ready notifications and display a background generation readiness banner component on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait times average 201s median / 2336s mean, leading users to switch windows and drop out before pet creation finishes.

components.text: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet creation is complete!

guard.reason: Adds a readiness notification banner on the waiting screen while fulfilling its core job.

candidates.score_note: Desktop background ready notifications consistently win (+3.2% to +5.1%).

candidates.title: Pet Progress Cloud Backup Headline on Sign-In
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize backing up pet progress to prevent data reset.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after re-authenticating; framing account sign-in around data protection builds trust.

sign_in.headline: Back Up Your Pet to the Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in to save your pet's memory and ensure your companion data is never lost.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to mention cloud backup without dark patterns or pricing references.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints, but copy updates consistently show no clear effect.

candidates.title: Mascot Animation Progress Display on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Show progress status and an animated pet working mascot component on the waiting screen during generation.
candidates.why: The home stage features a long waiting period (201s median), causing drop-offs; active visual feedback reassures waiting users.

guard.reason: Adds animated mascot progress indicator to the waiting screen during creation.

candidates.score_note: Waiting screen progress displays consistently showed no clear effect (+0.4%).

Redesigns and layout changes often showed no clear effect or caused severe negative drops (-17.2%), though the Stage Layout Pick Friend redesign was helpful (+7.1% won).
Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1% won) and path selection helper hints (+3.5% won) were helpful, but sound cues, notification toggles/banners, and overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Copy updates and waiting screen progress or time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently over-optimistic for non-winning tests, predicting up to +12.0% where no clear effect was measured.
